gloss: to accomplish, to achieve, to carry through

definitions.gloss: to accomplish, to achieve, to carry through to completion
definitions.explanation: To successfully complete a difficult or significant undertaking. Emphasizes the completion of something that required sustained effort or determination.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きなことを{成|な}し{遂|と}げた。
{目標|もくひょう}を{成|な}し{遂|と}げるまで{諦|あきら}めない。
examples.english: I won't give up until I achieve my goal.

examples.japanese: {困難|こんなん}を{乗|の}り{越|こ}え、チームは{見事|みごと}にプロジェクトを{成|な}し{遂|と}げた。
examples.english: Overcoming difficulties, the team brilliantly completed the project.

notes:
{成|な}し{遂|と}げる is a compound verb combining {成|な}す (to accomplish, to form) and {遂|と}げる (to carry through to the end).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pattern: ～を{成|な}し{遂|と}げる

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {偉業|いぎょう}を{成|な}し{遂|と}げる: to accomplish a great feat
- {目標|もくひょう}を{成|な}し{遂|と}げる: to achieve a goal
- {使命|しめい}を{成|な}し{遂|と}げる: to fulfill a mission
- {改革|かいかく}を{成|な}し{遂|と}げる: to carry out a reform

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {成|な}し{遂|と}げる: to accomplish (emphasizes completion of something significant)
- {達成|たっせい}する: to achieve, to attain (more neutral, common in business)
- {果|は}たす: to fulfill, to carry out (duty or promise)
- やり{遂|と}げる: to see through to the end (more colloquial)
